_about: Schools that have closed, are closing, merged or changed in ways federal data hasn't caught up with yet. kind: closed | closing | merged | changed. listed:false hides the school from the directory, state and topic lists, similar-school suggestions and the sitemap; its page stays up with the notice. Recheck each entry when the Scorecard pull changes.

trinity-christian-college.headline: Trinity Christian College has closed.
trinity-christian-college.text: The college closed after the 2025–26 school year and held its last commencement in 2026. It arranged teach-outs with Saint Xavier University, Calvin University and Olivet Nazarene University so current students could finish their degrees. The numbers below describe the college before it closed.

sources.title: Trinity Christian College to close after 2025-26 academic year | Higher Ed Dive

university-of-providence.headline: The University of Providence is closing in summer 2027.
university-of-providence.text: Its board voted on October 27, 2026, to close at the end of summer 2027. The university says it will share a teach-out plan and keep current students' out-of-pocket costs from going above what they would have paid if it stayed open. If you're thinking about applying, talk to the university first.

sources.title: University of Providence to shutter in summer 2027 | Higher Ed Dive
University of Providence to close following 2026-27 academic year | NBC Montana

cambridge-college.headline: Cambridge College is now part of Bay Path University.
cambridge-college.text: Bay Path University completed its acquisition of Cambridge College on July 1, 2024. Cambridge College still enrolls students and runs its own programs as part of Bay Path.

sources.title: Bay Path University officially acquires Cambridge College | Cambridge College

northcentral-university.headline: Northcentral University is now part of National University.
northcentral-university.text: The two universities completed their merger in fall 2022. Northcentral's programs and faculty continue under National University, so apply there instead.

sources.title: National and Northcentral have merged | National University

trinity-international-university-illinoi.headline: Trinity International University no longer offers on-campus undergraduate study in Deerfield.
trinity-international-university-illinoi.text: In March 2023 its board voted to end residential and in-person undergraduate education after that spring, apart from a combined BA/MDiv program. Its undergraduate college moved fully online. Its divinity and law schools still hold in-person programs.

sources.title: Reimagining the Future | Trinity International University

bethany-global-university.headline: Bethany Global University has moved online.
bethany-global-university.text: In 2024 the university shifted from in-person classes to an online platform and put its 32-acre Bloomington campus up for sale. Its first full-time online class started in fall 2024.

sources.title: Transwestern markets prime 32-acre site in Bloomington, Minnesota | Transwestern
